policy: REDACT names of private individuals (parties, witnesses, victims, family, minors, and any other named private person) in every variant; their home/residential addresses (full or partial street references); and SSNs in every form (full, undashed, spaced, masked, last-four). KEEP names inside citations to other cases, judges and court staff, attorneys of record, police acting officially, organizations and their business addresses, and all other numbers (phones, case/account/routing/EIN/Bates/invoice/claim numbers, dates, DOBs).
occurrenceRule: Page text = mupdf toStructuredText('preserve-whitespace').asText() with every whitespace run collapsed to one space and trimmed. occurrence = number of earlier start positions (case-sensitive, overlapping, plain substring) of the exact span text on that page. start = char offset of the span in that normalized page text.
